findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name XML external entity expansion
 * @description Parsing XML with external entity resolution enabled can lead to XXE attacks
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/xxe
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-611
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("xml").getMember("etree").getMember("ElementTree").getMember("parse").getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("xml").getMember("etree").getMember("ElementTree").getMember("fromstring").getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("xml").getMember("dom").getMember("minidom").getMember("parse").getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("xml").getMember("dom").getMember("minidom").getMember("parseString").getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("xml").getMember("sax").getMember("parse").getACall()
  )
select call, "Potentially unsafe XML parsing without external entity protection."
findings.hypothesis: Check for XML parsing operations that might be vulnerable to XXE attacks

message.text: Potentially unsafe XML parsing without external entity protection.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Unsafe shell command execution
 * @description Using shell=True or os.system can be dangerous if user input is involved
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/unsafe-shell-command
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-078
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    // subprocess.call/run/Popen with shell=True
    exists(DataFlow::Node shellArg |
      call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["call", "run", "Popen", "check_call", "check_output"]).getACall() and
      shellArg = call.getArgByName("shell") and
      shellArg.asExpr().(BooleanLiteral).booleanValue() = true
    )
    or
    // os.system calls
    call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember("system").getACall()
    or
    // os.popen calls
    call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember("popen").getACall()
  )
select call, "Potentially unsafe shell command execution that could be exploited if user input reaches this call."
findings.hypothesis: Check for shell command execution patterns that use shell=True or os.system/os.popen which could be dangerous

message.text: Potentially unsafe shell command execution that could be exploited if user input reaches this call.
